disclaimer: We are students, not medical professionals. CalmCampus does not diagnose or treat; it helps students notice early signs and reach the right support.

steady.title: Things look steady this week
steady.body: You did not mark any of the four signs. That is good to know. A quick check-in each week helps you notice if this changes.

notice.title: You noticed one thing
notice.body: One of the signs showed up this week. That is common, and worth a small pause. Talking it through early often makes it lighter.

support.title: A few signs are showing up
support.body: Two signs showed up this week. This is a good moment to talk to someone before things build up. One conversation can help you sort out what to do first.

care.title: This week sounds heavy
care.body: Three or four signs showed up. You do not have to carry that alone. Someone who can look at the whole picture with you can help, and reaching out is a normal thing to do.

privacy.title: Your privacy, in plain words
privacy.intro: CalmCampus is built so that your answers belong to you and nobody else.

points.h: Your answers stay on this phone
points.p: They are saved in your browser's local storage. They are never sent to a server, to {name}, or to the CalmCampus team.
There is no sign-up, no analytics and no trackers. Fonts and icons are bundled in the app, so it does not load anything from other companies.
We keep yes or no answers and the week they belong to. No name, email, location or free text.

points.h: What the website host can see
points.p: Like any website, the host that delivers the app files may keep standard technical logs, such as a connection time and address. They never contain your answers, because your answers never leave your phone.
Clear everything at any time with Start over in the About tab. Clearing your browser data does the same.
Send feedback opens an email draft. Nothing is attached, and nothing is sent until you press send yourself.

It uses no real student data. The earlier weeks and the phone data you see are made up and labelled Example. This web version cannot read Apple Health or Screen Time; the full app is designed to, on the phone only.

privacy.principles: We follow the design principles of the Swiss nLPD and the GDPR: data minimisation, purpose limitation, transparency and user control. This is a statement of how the app is designed. It is not a certification or an audit.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.lead: CalmCampus helps students notice early signs of stress and find the right support. This is a preview for {name}: try it the way a student would. It takes about five minutes.
points: Answer four yes or no questions about your week. It takes less than a minute.
The full app also looks at sleep, steps and late phone use. Here these are examples, not your real data.
Nothing you enter leaves this phone.
welcome.later: You can find all of this again under About.

about.title: About this preview
about.intro: CalmCampus helps students notice early signs of stress and find the right support at {name}. This preview shows how it would work. The past weeks and the phone data are examples. Your own answers stay on this phone.

install.title: Add it to your home screen
ios: Tap Share: the square with an arrow. On newer iPhones it can be under the ••• button.
Open CalmCampus from its new icon.
android: Tap the menu: the three dots at the top right.
Choose Add to Home screen or Install app.
Open CalmCampus from its new icon.
